tasks.description: Investigate how temperature (T) and relative humidity (RH) affect sensor responses, particularly focusing on PT08.S1(CO), PT08.S2(NMHC), PT08.S3(NOx), and PT08.S4(NO2).
Develop a model to estimate Benzene (C6H6) concentration using available sensor readings and compare with C6H6(GT) ground truth values.

tasks.task_name: Identify Daily Patterns in Sensor Readings
